content.title: Software Engineering Internship · BAIUST Computer Club
content.summary: A six-month software engineering internship combining React frontend work with an Arduino-based bus tracking system.
content.body: July 2025 – December 2025. Completed a structured six-month Software Engineering Internship Program. Built frontend components using React in a team-based development environment, and designed and implemented a bus tracking system involving Arduino-based hardware and embedded programming.
content.notes: This entry keeps the frontend and embedded contributions together because both were part of the supplied internship description.

evidence.claim: The supplied CV lists a Software Engineering Internship at BAIUST Computer Club from July 2025 to December 2025, including React frontend work and an Arduino-based bus tracking system.
evidence.note: Source reviewed: the CV content supplied by the owner in this task. No public program, repository, or project URL was supplied.
